title: Monthly burn flags & asks — finance ops prep
body:
Purpose: prep notes for quick monthly finance ops sync with Eng/Product partners (15–20m). Focus: run-rate variances, urgent procurement approvals that affect Q4 cadence, and a small set of follow-ups I need decisions on before the exec report.

Meeting: Finance Ops monthly catch-up (sync) — 2024-11-05 (tentative)
Attendees to target: Avery (owner), Jordan (Finance PM), Ellen (Platform Eng finance lead), Kiran (Head of Platform Eng), Priya (SRE budget owner)

Agenda (15–20m):
- 0–3m: quick numbers + one-line context (ask: signoff? defer?)
- 3–10m: procurement ask & approval decisions (see matrix)
- 10–16m: run-rate variance root cause + immediate mitigations
- 16–20m: owners + due dates + follow-ups (capture)

Quick numbers (current as of last close):
- Current run-rate (net infra + licenses + cloud): ~$8.9M/month 
- Month-over-month change (Sep→Oct): +6.2% (~$520k) driven by: dedicated GPU spot spike ($320k), embeddings infra cache misconfig (~$120k), and 3rd-party observability license ramp ($80k)
- Q4 forecast (baseline): $8.6M/mo; current burn puts us ~+3.5% vs baseline if no mitigations

Procurement asks (urgent):
1) GPU reserved capacity top-up (vendor: HorizonCloud) — $1.2M annual (~$100k/mo)
   - Why: demand spike for dedicated customers; without top-up we throttle mid-Nov and risk SLA breaches
   - Decision threshold: approve commit now (exec-signed PO) OR approve 3-month bridge with overage protection
   - Stakeholders: Kiran (tech owner), Jordan (finance), Legal (contract review: FIN-4890)
2) Observability license pause negotiation (Datapulse) — reduce seat count for non-customer-facing teams
   - Target saving: ~$45k/mo; low product impact if paused for 8 weeks
   - Need: Priya to confirm list of seats safe to pause
3) One-off multi-region DR rehearsal external vendor (CloudOpsCo) — $65k one-time
   - Benefit: reduces SRE manual effort during DR windows; can be scoped smaller to $30k

Decision matrix (what I need in the meeting):
- GPU top-up: Approve full annual commit OR approve 3mo bridge + re-evaluate Jan 2025
- Datapulse: Approve seat pause scope + owner to action (Priya)
- CloudOpsCo: Approve scoped PoC ($30k) if Kiran signs technical scope

Run-rate variance analysis (short):
- Primary cause: unplanned burst from dedicated GPU usage (new customer rollout + ineffective batch shaping)
- Secondary: emulator test cluster left at high concurrency for 9 days (ticket FIN-4872)
- Short mitigations (actionable this week):
  - Force batch-shaping config rollback (Eng on-call) — owner: Kiran — target 24h
  - Suspend non-prod GPU queues for 72h — owner: Priya — target 48h
  - Negotiation with HorizonCloud to defer invoices until commit discussion — owner: Jordan — target EOD +3

Follow-ups & action items (to capture during meeting):
- Jordan: draft PO language for 3mo bridge + outline exec approval path — due 2024-11-06
- Kiran: provide technical signoff + scoped alternatives for top-up (e.g., fractional allocation, overage cap) — due 2024-11-07
- Priya: list seats to pause in Datapulse with impact notes — due 2024-11-06
- Avery: prepare exec summary + two-slide ask for Monday report (include run-rate delta and mitigation plan) — due 2024-11-08
- Legal (Ellen to ping): expedite FIN-4890 contract review — due 2024-11-09

Draft lines for exec summary (keep short):
- "We observed a temporary run-rate increase (+6%) due to dedicated GPU demand and an operations configuration error. Proposed immediate actions reduce near-term overrun by ~60% with limited customer impact. Request approval for a 3-month bridge for capacity while we stabilize batch shaping and complete cost optimizations."

Slack/comms plan (post-meeting):
- If GPU top-up approved: short Slack to #exec-finance and #platform-ops with one-paragraph ask + link to PO draft
- If only bridge approved: same channels + cc sales-led customer success for impacted commitments

Notes to self / open questions: 
- Is there appetite to use Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + cache tuning) to offset 20–30% of GPU needs by Jan? Need research estimate (Rohan)
- Consider offering a temporary premium surcharge to Dedicated customers onboarding Nov→Dec to offset marginal cost — run quick pricing sensitivity with Sales (Maya)
- Confirm whether third-party license discounts are eligible under existing vendor master (Legal)

Quick checklist to run before meeting: 
- Pull last 7 days infra usage heatmap (Observability console) — done? [ ]
- Snapshot of committed contracts and billing cadence for HorizonCloud — done? [ ]
- Short slide (2) with numbers + ask — done? [ ]

End — keep this doc short in meeting, expand into PO/exec note after decisions.

Revision history: personal scratchpad, iter 1 — will convert to shared drive finance doc if decisions require full paper.
